example.title: Residence of J.L. Plum, 726 Iowa Ave. (real-photo postcard, c.1915)

brief: Two-storey Colonial Revival / Free Classic house near the university (seen on a c.1915 postcard): hipped roof with a big front gable and a hipped dormer, a tall brick chimney, and a deep full-width front porch on round classical columns with a small pediment over the steps and a turned-baluster rail. Clapboard walls (colours assumed: white body, dark roof), stone porch base; huge elms and a spruce in the yard, frame outbuildings behind.
